ios.desc:
Introducing Limpio: Your Gateway to Distraction-Free Efficiency

Limpio isn't just another home screen launcher—it's your ticket to a more focused digital lifestyle. In a world overflowing with notifications and distractions, we've engineered a solution that puts your attention back where it belongs: on the tasks that truly matter to you.

Here's how Limpio revolutionizes your smartphone experience:

Streamlined Home Screen:
Bid farewell to cluttered displays. With our sleek widget, accessing your essential apps is swift and elegant, free from the visual overload that typically plagues traditional home screens.

Reclaim Your Focus:
Say goodbye to interruptions. Limpio doesn't just hide notifications; it quiets all distractions, empowering you to seize control of your concentration and engage with your device as a potent tool, rather than a constant source of disruption.

Effortless Usability:
Simplicity is our guiding principle. Installing our widget takes just 60 seconds, and once it graces your home screen, navigating your essential apps becomes second nature.

Smooth Transition with Loading Companions:
Transitioning from your conventional home screen to Limpio is seamless and intuitive. Our loading companions ensure a smooth migration to a distraction-free environment, allowing you to enjoy focused productivity from the get-go with a cute pal.

Uncompromising Security:
Your privacy is paramount. Limpio is founded on principles of transparency, privacy, and data ownership. Your personal information remains just that—personal.

Experience the freedom of a clutter-free smartphone experience with Limpio. Embrace efficiency. Embrace focus. Embrace Limpio.

quotes.text: Smartphones are designed to keep you hooked, with billions spent ensuring you stay glued to your screen. Limpio breaks you free from their control. Our powerful app transforms your homescreen into a clean, distraction-free design, helping you reclaim your time and focus on what truly matters.
quotes.title: Show HN: Powerful Digital Minimizer

quotes.text:
Hey,
I'm Kenny and I realized I was spending a lot of time on my phone. So I built my first IOS Application to dumbify the smart phone (Limpio). I have been increasingly spending more time on my phone and was looking for ways to be more productive by making my phone less appealing. I wasn't prepared to completely give up my phone and switch to the lite phone, but I also wanted to do something about it. So, I coded this app to be create a less appealing environment in order decrease screen time.

So far it has been working for me, having my average week screen time go down from 5 hours to 3. I forgot to put the link on the post, but here it is: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/limpio/id6502041177?ref=today.tools

Thank you

quotes.text: I created an app that allows you dumbify your iPhone with a lot of cool features. You can edit your app names to customize each view, you can edit the url scheme to enter apps at specific points, or call specific people, look up your favorite websites all from your home page! You can also add emojis to the app views and change the color of the background. A very open app with a lot of power if used right. Updates are on the way too!
